You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was the trench system on the Western Front as a cause of stalemate? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant were shortages on the German Home Front as a reason for revolution towards the
end of 1918? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was their ideology as a reason for the Nazis’ lack of electoral success before 1930?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Himmler to the Nazis in dealing with opposition after 1933? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important were opposition parties as a reason for instability in Russia by 1914? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was Trotsky’s leadership of the Red Army as a reason for Bolshevik victory in the
Russian Civil War? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important were falling prices as a reason why farmers struggled in the USA in the 1920s?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was religion as a reason for the introduction of Prohibition in 1920? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the modernisation of industry to the economic growth of China by 1960? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant were China’s relations with neighbouring states to its development as a world power
by 1976? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
11 How important was farming to the development of the economy in South Africa by 1948? Explain
your answer. [40]
12 How significant was anti-communism as a reason for government repression of political opponents
after 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
13 How important was Nasser as a cause of the increased hostility between Egypt and Israel during
his time as president? Explain your answer. [40]
14 How significant was the 1977 Israeli election victory of Likud in the peace process to 1994? Explain
your answer. [40]
